in_chain_replicate.role: the delivering branch: LEFT of both contrasts

twin.role: the in-flight twin: RIGHT of the null contrast

boundary: A development read on a TRAIN fold (owner decisions 28 and 86); never a test claim; branch-local, never a system-level claim. No utterance text, transcript, gold label or model output is printed or persisted.
decision_rule: SAME-FLIGHT PERCEPTION-BRANCH READ (owner decision 184; level 2; claim ceiling 'nominated', ruling O1). Per branch (a-agree delivering, b-top2contrast, t-twin): the sealed branch note's candidate list gives gold's rank (1/2/3/absent), top1 and present offline (gold enters only offline); the branch's level-2 first-visit Solver answer is rendered through the delivered row's normaliser and projection and scored ONCE with slurp-slu-official-train (score_complete_derived_copy); A's column is A's own first Solver answer. Every contrast is a paired ROW bootstrap (cluster key sample_id, 10,000 draws, seed 20260929); the utterance-level number is reported beside and never gates. (1) THE TWIN NULL: T minus A per metric; the bar = |T - A offset| + its CI95 half-width, reported beside the provisional floor 0.3163 pp. (2) THE CONTRAST: b-top2contrast minus A on the level-2 branch Solver column's official intent accuracy (primary). NOMINATED iff the intent CI95 lower bound is above zero AND the point delta exceeds the twin's intent bar AND the SLU-F1 CI95 lower bound of the same column is not below minus the twin's SLU bar (guard). BRANCH-LOCAL HARM iff the intent CI95 upper bound is below zero and the point magnitude exceeds the twin bar. Otherwise NOT NOMINATED. Reported beside, never gating: gold-on-list and mean gold rank of the B note vs A and T, the conversion P(correct | gold rank r in the branch note) against the ledger's 97.57 / 26.98 / 12.0 %, the rows where top2-contrast-v1 rendered nothing (presentation_skip_reason, ruling O5), and the delivered row (identical by construction). A nomination sends the composed policy to a full-system cross-flight read against an in-chain A/A; it admits nothing.

2. Level 1 (note): per branch gold rank / present / top1 from the sealed note (gold offline); scripts/analysis/slurp_perception_branch_read.py refuses unless branch A reproduces the ledger driver's P-node counting.
3. Level 2 (answer): render each branch's first-visit Solver answer through the delivered row's normaliser and projection and score it ONCE with slurp-slu-official-train (never sharded).
4. Twin null (T vs A), then B vs A under the rule; per-scenario tables in both weightings.
